title: Advogado Sênior (EUDR)
description:
Você conhece a Bunge?

Distribuída em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 117 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos. Valorizamos a diversidade de nossos times e buscamos talentos criativos com espírito de equipe e vontade de fazer a diferença. Em tudo o que fazemos, colocamos em prática nossos valores:

  • Atuar como um só time, promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  • Buscar a excelência, sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  • Fazer o que é certo, agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

Missão do Cargo

Como advogado(a) nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na condução de assuntos relacionados ao EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento) e outras questões socioambientais. Você fornecerá suporte jurídico especializado e estratégico para garantir a conformidade com o EUDR, com foco na devida diligência em relação à origem dos produtos, à verificação do cumprimento da legislação aplicável nos países produtores (incluindo direitos humanos, direitos dos povos indígenas e comunidades locais) e à mitigação de riscos. Seu background generalista em áreas como Direito Tributário, Trabalhista e Compliance será um diferencial para uma atuação integrada e completa.

Atividades e Responsabilidades

Consultoria Jurídica:

  • Consultoria jurídica especializada para a área de direitos humanos e sustentabilidade em conformidade com o EUDR (Regulamento da União Europeia sobre Produtos Livres de Desmatamento), bem como nas demais áreas de legalidade exigidos pelo EUDR, como trabalhista, tributário, compliance, entre outras, baseada nos procedimentos e políticas internas da companhia.
  • Elaboração de pareceres e memorandos jurídicos com a avaliação de risco, com base na documentação analisada para evidenciar a devida diligência por parte da empresa.

Contencioso:

  • Análise de processos administrativos e judiciais,considerando os aspectos relacionados à conformidade com a EUDR.
  • Análise de documentos processuais, incluindo processo de licenciamento, licenças ambientais, estudos de impacto ambiental, autorizações de supressão vegetal, TAC, plano de manejo, etc.,verificando sua conformidade com os requisitos do EUDR.
  • Acompanhar e controlar o fluxo dos processos desenvolvidos por advogados externos,garantindo a conformidade com a estratégia da empresa em relação ao EUDR.

Compliance:

  • Realização de controles internos utilizando o sistema jurídico interno.
  • Acompanhamento legislativo e reporte à gerência e diretoria jurídica sobre os impactos das alterações legislativas no negócio, com foco em legislação socioambiental,incluindo atualizações e análises sobre o EUDR e outras regulamentações internacionais relevantes.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, considerando os riscos legais, reputacionais e financeiros associados ao descumprimento do EUDR.
  • Elaboração de relatórios dedue diligenceem direitos humanos e sustentabilidade,com foco na diligência devida e os requisitos de rastreabilidade e transparência da cadeia de suprimentos do EUDR.

Outras atividades:

  • Participação em grupos de trabalho, internos e externos, interagindo com diferentesstakeholders,com foco em EUDR e outras questões socioambientais relevantes.
  • Prover treinamentos às áreas de interface.

Impacto/Dimensão

O(A) Advogado(a) desta posição desempenha um papel estratégico na mitigação de riscos e na geração de valor para a empresa, contribuindo diretamente para:

  • Redução de passivos ambientais e sociais: Através da análise criteriosa de documentos e da emissão de pareceres jurídicos, o(a) profissional contribui para a prevenção de multas e processos judiciais, gerando uma economia à empresa.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com a legislação e as melhores práticas: A atuação do(a) advogado(a) garante que os projetos e as operações da empresa estejam em conformidade com as leis e normas socioambientais, evitando sanções e danos reputacionais. Isso envolve a análise de diversos documentos por ano e a emissão de pareceres que subsidiam decisões estratégicas à área de originação, sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.
  • Promoção da sustentabilidade e dos direitos humanos: O(A) profissional atua ativamente na implementação de políticas e práticas de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos, contribuindo para o alcance dos Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável. Isso inclui a participação em diversos projetos por ano, com alcance nacional e internacional, e a interação com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Fortalecimento da reputação da empresa: A atuação jurídica ética e responsável na área de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos contribui para o fortalecimento da imagem da empresa perante seus stakeholders, gerando valor para a marca e atraindo investimentos.

Key Performance Indicators ( KPIs)

Alcance dos objetivos estratégicos especialmente focados na área de consultoria jurídica para as áreas de sustentabilidade e direitos humanos.

Principais Oportunidades e Decisões

  • Visão de futuro
  • Visão estratégica

  • Planejamento e organização

Key Relationships, Stakeholders & Interfaces

  • Gerentes, Coordenadores, Advogados

Conhecimento e Competências Técnicas

  • Superior Completo em: Direito
  • Cursos/Conhecimentos Específicos, cite:

- Direito Ambiental, ESG, Direitos Humanos, Mudanças Climáticas, Carbono

- Experiência de atuação em perfil generalista com conhecimentos gerais em trabalhista, tributário, compliance.

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil.
Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável.
Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG).
Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas.
Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.
O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois!

Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil.

• Excelência no Atendimento
• Jeito simples e alegre de ser

Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família!
Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo.

description:
Join us to apply for the KYC Client Onboarding Analyst role at Macquarie Group .

Join our Commodities and Global Markets team in Sao Paulo, Brazil, as a KYC Client Onboarding Analyst. The analyst will provide concierge-style support to our sales and marketing staff, responsible for all client onboarding and lifecycle management activities. The sales staff will rely on you for process updates, knowing that the coordination of internal stakeholder processes is in capable, competent, and trusted hands.

At Macquarie, our advantage is bringing together diverse people and empowering them to shape all kinds of possibilities. We are a global financial services group operating in 31 markets with 56 years of unbroken profitability. You’ll be part of a friendly and supportive team where everyone contributes ideas and drives outcomes.

What role will you play?

In this role, you will join a high-performing and accountable team, engaging with stakeholders including clients, business units, operations, and support and risk groups. You will be responsible for identifying and escalating high-risk triggers and other potential risk findings, maintaining accurate data and documents in our customer databases, and managing clients’ expectations during onboarding and refresh processes. Building and maintaining credible relationships across all organizational levels will be essential.

Resumes in English preferred.

What You Offer

  • Two years of KYC / Client Lifecycle Maintenance (CLM) experience in financial services, commodities, markets, or consulting
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English (spoken and written)
  • Strong knowledge of onboarding policies and jurisdictional KYC regulations
  • Attention to detail, critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work in a dynamic environment that values constructive input and innovation

We welcome applicants inspired to build a better future with us. If you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie, we encourage you to apply.

About Commodities and Global Markets

This division offers capital and financing, risk management, market access, physical execution, and logistics solutions to a diverse client base across commodities, financial markets, and asset finance.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

We are dedicated to creating a workplace that embraces diversity, equity, and inclusion. We also aim to provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process and employment.

description:

For Buenos Aires and Mexico City candidates: Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.
For Mexico City candidates: Only applications of candidates with Mexican citizenship will be evaluated for this role in compliance with the provisions of Article 7 of the Federal Labor Law.
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Buenos Aires, Argentina; Mexico City, CDMX, Mexico .Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in advertising sales, marketing, consulting, or media (e.g., search, social, mobile, display, and video media), and creating customer-facing materials (e.g., pitches, narratives, or one-sheets) for sales teams.

Preferred qualifications:
  • 5 years of experience in data-driven marketing, advertising technologies and business analytics tools (e.g., Analytics 4).
  • 3 years of Experience with third-party data integration tools or platforms.
  • Understanding of the industry's data and tech ecosystem.
  • Ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally.
  • Excellent project management and problem-solving skills.
About The Job
Being an Analyst at Google is about much more than simply crunching numbers – it’s about finding compelling insights within data and using your exceptional business and communication skills to translate those insights into action. As one of the masterminds behind our strategic planning, forecasting and analysis, you’ll spend your time digging into big, complex data sets. The data will not remain inert in your hands, however, since you’ll use your critical thinking, problem solving and communication skills to influence and drive thoughtful and well-informed decision making with our most senior business leaders within the organization, and potentially some of our biggest clients.
As a Data Integration and Measurement Lead within the Product team, your primary role will be to drive data maturity and establish robust measurement strategies across Spanish-speaking Latin American markets and their key clients. This involves providing deep expertise in data integration, and comprehensive measurement approaches, all while ensuring the adoption of Google's products. You will offer expert guidance on data integration and privacy solutions, empowering sales teams and clients to maximize their campaign effectiveness and overall business outcomes. You will analyze data-driven insights to optimize performance, educate stakeholders on privacy-first measurement techniques, and facilitate the seamless integration of data and measurement best practices across various teams and platforms. You will also serve as a central point of contact for data integration expertise, ensuring strategic alignment, driving measurable growth, and exceeding performance targets across the digital landscape. Furthermore, you will act as a crucial liaison between global product teams and regional sales/client support teams.
Global Solutions is the link between Google products and business. Your focus is to help turn innovation into complete, packaged tools that allow our customers to get the most that they need from our products. As part of the Global Solutions team, you'll help to ensure that Google has adopted the right strategy for our products. Working in one of three specialized areas – Performance, Brand, or Publisher & Platform – you'll use your expertise to help front-line Sales partners to work their magic quickly and effectively. You are passionate about all things digital, and want to help shape the world of online advertising.
Responsibilities
  • Act as the key liaison with global teams to communicate the needs and bring product launches and recommendations to sales teams, taking 100% ownership of assigned products.
  • Work and collaborate with numerous cross-functional teams to set the strategy for your products to achieve desired adoption.
  • Educate Google's ecosystem and present solutions to various internal and external audiences.
  • Engage in specific client conversations when necessary, understand their business objectives and how the solutions can address their challenges.
  • Increase the advertiser's Digital AI maturity and overall media investment through the strategic usage of Data and Measurement technology.

Descrição:

Profissional responsável por apoiar as atividades regulatórias nacionais e internacionais, incluindo a manutenção de registros sanitários, submissões técnicas, elaboração e atualização de dossiês regulatórios, resposta a exigências de agências reguladoras, análise regulatória de mudanças (Change Control) e interface com áreas técnicas para avaliação de impacto regulatório.

Atuará em conformidade com os requisitos aplicáveis a produtos sujeitos à vigilância sanitária (dispositivos médicos, IVDs e medicamentos), com foco em regulamentações da ANVISA, FDA (21 CFR Part 820 / 314) e MDR/IVDR. Também dará suporte à implementação e manutenção de processos internos para garantir a conformidade regulatória ao longo do ciclo de vida do produto, incluindo participação em auditorias e inspeções regulatórias nacionais e internacionais.

Profissional sênior responsável por liderar e executar atividades regulatórias nacionais e internacionais, incluindo:

  • Elaboração, submissão e manutenção de dossiês regulatórios para dispositivos médicos, IVDs e/ou medicamentos;
  • Interação direta com autoridades reguladoras (ANVISA, FDA, EMA, entre outras);
  • Análise regulatória de alterações técnicas e administrativas (Change Control);
  • Avaliação de impacto regulatório no ciclo de vida de produtos em conformidade com legislações vigentes (RDCs, 21 CFR, MDR/IVDR);
  • Preparação e suporte a auditorias regulatórias e inspeções sanitárias;
  • Desenvolvimento e padronização de processos regulatórios internos alinhados às melhores práticas da indústria (como Boston Scientific, Medtronic, Abbott);
  • Acompanhamento de novos marcos regulatórios e atualização contínua da estratégia regulatória da empresa.

Espera-se que o profissional atue com alto grau de autonomia técnica, capacidade de tomada de decisão e habilidade para orientar, revisar e dar feedback técnico à equipe júnior, apoiando o desenvolvimento interno e a consistência das entregas regulatórias.


Requisitos:
  • Formação superior completa em Ciências da Vida (ex: Farmácia, Biomedicina, Biotecnologia, Biologia) ou Ciências Exatas (ex: Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia Química);
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em Assuntos Regulatórios na indústria de produtos para saúde (dispositivos médicos, IVDs e/ou medicamentos), com atuação comprovada em submissões nacionais e internacionais;
  • Domínio técnico das regulamentações aplicáveis: ANVISA (ex: RDCs 751/2022, 665/2022, 74/2016, 185/2001), FDA (21 CFR Parts 820, 807, 314) e Regulamentos Europeus (EU MDR 2017/745, IVDR 2017/746);
  • Vivência com sistemas eletrônicos de submissão e rastreabilidade, como eSTAR, eCTD, RJS, Solicita, Datavisa e eSubmission Gateway;
  • Habilidade comprovada em redação técnica de dossiês e interpretação crítica de normas, guias regulatórios e pareceres técnicos;
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e comunicação verbal) — fluência será avaliada;
  • Forte senso de organização, priorização e habilidade de mentoria, com postura colaborativa para fornecer feedback técnico estruturado, treinar analistas e garantir o alinhamento regulatório das entregas.

VEM PRA MADEIRA!!!

Sobre a vaga

O Especialista de Projetos, integrado à área de Consultoria Interna, tem como responsabilidade garantir a execução eficaz das iniciativas estratégicas e táticas prioritárias, atuando como elo entre a definição estratégica e a implementação prática. Sua missão é centralizar a gestão dos projetos, desde o planejamento, definição de cronogramas e recursos até a entrega final, assegurando o alinhamento contínuo com os objetivos organizacionais. Irá focar na execução, governança, monitoramento de KPIs, controle de prazos, custos e escopos, bem como na gestão de riscos e na resolução de problemas operacionais. A Consultoria Interna, por sua vez, identifica oportunidades, realiza diagnósticos e define as prioridades estratégicas. Juntas, essas áreas garantem a execução bem-sucedida dos projetos, assegurando que entreguem resultados consistentes e sustentáveis, sempre alinhados às metas financeiras e operacionais da empresa. Esse modelo de trabalho integrado contribui de forma eficaz para a transformação organizacional, promovendo melhorias contínuas e a excelência operacional.

Responsabilidades

O Especialista de Projetos, tem foco em execução prática, assegurando que os projetos sejam conduzidos de forma ágil e eficaz, garantindo resultados tangíveis e alinhamento estratégico com os objetivos organizacionais.

Atividades que você vai protagonizar:

Estruturação de Projetos:

  • Traduzir as iniciativas estratégicas e demandas operacionais em projetos bem definidos, com objetivos claros, metas SMART e resultados esperados;
  • Detalhar cronogramas, escopos, responsáveis, entregáveis e recursos necessários para cada projeto, aplicando as metodologias adequadas (ágil, tradicional, híbrida);
  • Executar as tarefas e atividades diretamente dentro dos projetos para garantir que as ações estejam alinhadas com os objetivos definidos.

Fóruns de Alinhamento:

  • Facilitar reuniões periódicas com as equipes e stakeholders para revisar o andamento dos projetos, identificar riscos e propor soluções corretivas;
  • Garantir que todos os envolvidos no projeto estejam alinhados e engajados, promovendo a transparência e a colaboração, e reportar as discussões e decisões ao PMO departamental.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Identificar riscos específicos para cada projeto (atrasos, falta de recursos, mudanças no escopo) e implementar planos de mitigação;
  • Reportar riscos identificados ao PMO departamental e trabalhar na implementação de medidas corretivas, alinhando-se à governança corporativa.

Orçamento de Projetos:

  • Trabalhar diretamente com o FP&A, área de consultoria interna e demais stakeholders para criar orçamentos detalhados, incluindo todos os custos previstos para o projeto;
  • Acompanhar as despesas do projeto, alertando sobre desvios de orçamento e ajustando o planejamento financeiro conforme os projetos avançam, com transparência e conformidade com as diretrizes do PMO departamental.

Gestão de Entregas:

  • Garantir que cada ação e entrega dos projetos seja realizada conforme o cronograma e escopo, supervisionando a implementação das melhorias propostas;
  • Trabalhar diretamente na execução das mudanças operacionais (como otimização de rotas ou reorganização de armazéns) e garantir que os resultados sejam entregues conforme o planejado, reportando o progresso ao PMO departamental.

Coordenação de Stakeholders:

  • Coordenar equipes internas e externas para garantir a execução fluida dos projetos e atender às necessidades de todos os stakeholders;
  • Reportar ao PMO departamental o andamento da execução, destacando pontos críticos e propondo soluções para resolução de possíveis conflitos.

Qualificações

???? Para montar o ambiente dos sonhos, não pode faltar:

  • Experiência robusta na condução de projetos estratégicos de ponta a ponta;
  • Experiência em preparação de reports para alta Gestão;
  • Habilidade para liderar e motivar equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e focado em resultados;
  • Proatividade na identificação, análise e mitigação de riscos que possam impactar o sucesso do projeto.

Formação:

  • Graduação: Administração, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Pós-Graduação/MBA: Gestão de Projetos.

Um toque especial na nossa decoração:

  • Experiência com metodologia Falconi;

About The Company
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.
We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

We are looking for talented professionals to join our Operations / Strategy team ! We are building a pipeline for multiple levels, ranging from Analyst (D5) to Senior Manager (D8+) roles, so if you know someone who would be a great fit, refer them now!
 As part of the Operations / Strategy team, the selected candidates will play a key role in optimizing processes, analyzing marketplace behavior, and driving innovation . This role requires a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive mindset to identify opportunities for improvement and efficiency. The ideal candidates will leverage data to develop strategies that impact pricing, demand, supply, and overall marketplace balance.
In this role, you'll be...

  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Use internal and external data to support pricing strategies, operational improvements, and business growth.
  • Innovation & Problem-Solving: Identify new opportunities and propose data-driven solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Engagement & Optimization: Create strategies to improve driver experience and engagement, ensuring marketplace efficiency.
  • Process & Product Improvement: Optimize existing workflows, support product enhancements, and ensure a seamless operational experience.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Business Administration, or related fields
  • 3 - 6 years of experience in data analytics, operations, or strategy roles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
Win-win Collaboration
Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
We believe in integrity
Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
Growth
We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
Diversity and Inclusion
Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion
Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.
We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

Join to apply for the Account Manager, App Ads, Monetization (English, Spanish) role at Google

For Buenos Aires and Mexico City applicants : Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.
For Mexico City applicants : Only applications of candidates with Mexican citizenship will be evaluated for this role in compliance with the provisions of Article 7 of the Federal Labor Law.
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Mexico City, CDMX, Mexico; Buenos Aires, Argentina .Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in consultative sales.
  • Experience in successfully implementing and optimizing ad monetization initiatives.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Spanish fluently to engage with local stakeholders.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, building strong relationships across departments, and influencing effectively across functions and executives.
  • Ability to structure, analyze, and solve business problems, and deliver impact against concrete business goals.
  • Ability to provide one-off consultations on apps-specific monetization strategies.
  • Ability to effectively communicate across a broad range of technical and non-technical stakeholders and build and deliver effective presentations.
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese fluently to engage with regional stakeholders as part of the scope of the role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
About The Job
Google’s Global Partnerships team powers extraordinary user experiences through partnerships that solve users’ needs, advance our partners’ goals, and further Google’s mission. Our team provides meaningful solutions from helping publishers and developers grow their businesses through monetization solutions, to helping our long-term partners anticipate and navigate change in a way that delivers economic and reputational value.
In this role, you will provide creative, industry-leading online advertising solutions for app publishers and developers and identify new opportunities. You will support some of the largest app publishers in LATAM as they rely on our products and we are always trying to exceed their expectations and strengthen our long-term partner relationships. You will help grow Google's business with the largest online publishers and provide account management for users of Admob, Google Ad Manager and more. You will provide client service, research, and market analysis, you will also problem-solve, using relevant Google and third-party data to develop a strategic perspective on customer focused insights and solutions. You will anticipate how decisions are made, explore and uncover the business needs of Google's key clients and showcase how our range of product offerings can grow their business. You will set the direction and strategy for how their monetization strategy impacts their business and their users. You will work with developers and be a trusted partner who will help them grow their businesses. You will work on engagement style across a variety of customers and cross-functional teams to set shared objectives, create open communication, build partnerships, and balance own interests to drive an impact while sharing best practices.
Responsibilities

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e novas tecnologias, além de multiplicar boas práticas

Organizar e divulgar as regras de segurança corporativas

  • Capacidade de gerar documentação leve, OKRs e planos de capacitação ágil;

ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.
Key responsabilities:

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.
  • Lead vegetation suppression processes, from field to reports elaboration;
  • Identify and assess project-related risks and impacts on species, habitats, and ecosystem functions, applying the mitigation hierarchy to avoid, minimize, and restore biodiversity loss.
  • Prepare technical documentation, including biotic environmental sections of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and compliance reports for regulators and financial institutions.

  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.
  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.
  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.
  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.
At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.

description:
Director, Technical Customer Support, Global Customer Support

Director, Technical Customer Support, Global Customer Support

Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
The Director of Technical Customer Support Focused Services will lead the LATAM team of highly experienced support teams delivering high touch services across the Palo Alto Networks security platform. These teams are focused on delivering outcome-based high touch support engagements to our largest, most strategic customers. You will collaborate with Account Teams, Engineering, NPI and Customer Success to create long-term support strategies required to successfully deliver cybersecurity support outcomes.
Your Impact

  • Leadership - Manage the delivery of a global service team delivering complex, multi-product services engagements
  • People Management - Set annual performance objectives for the team, ensure performance management processes are adhered to - provide continuous feedback to managers and individual contributors
  • Thought Leadership - Able to inspire the team to act as their customers’ trusted technical advisor
  • Build and Scale the Team - Interview, hire, train and onboard service delivery leaders consistent with our corporate values, recruiting processes and policy
  • Building Strategy - Establish the services delivery strategy, partnering with the account team on the adoption process where services can help
  • Strategic Thinking - Responsible for understanding our strategic client business strategy, drivers, security goals and initiatives and translating these into Palo Alto Networks service delivery plans and services opportunities
  • Results Leadership - Successfully driving the team to deliver goals and objectives as planned - completes training and is able to synthesize technical information into business language including business value, outcomes and impacts on our customers’ business and security objectives - Leading the team to make progress and to deliver on commitments
  • Business Development - Help position services sales with the account team by identifying incremental revenue opportunities focused on outcome-based packages and custom engagements
  • Business Management - Understands how financial performance of the teams contributes to the bookings, revenue and margin on the services business
  • Operations - Enhance the processes and tools for service delivery - Establish internal and external reporting cadence by monitoring and responding to key KPI’s
  • Collaboration - Partner with services leaders on strategy and on the delivery model to ensure a cohesive, collaborative approach to delivery
  • Technical Expertise - Ability to understand PANW solutions on a broad level and apply knowledge of the Cybersecurity industry to provide guidance to the team, collaborate with sales and other functions in the organization to provide guidance to customers so that customers successfully consume and leverage their purchased product portfolio
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • 10+ years of overall experience in the cybersecurity and Technical Customer Support in a TAC environment is preferred
  • 5+ years of senior leadership or managerial experience is required - This includes leading large teams, managing projects, and overseeing cybersecurity initiatives
  • Customer-facing services delivery experience, preferably in a technology company
  • Experience in partnering with account teams to drive successful platform adoption by applying the appropriate services and levels of support
  • Understanding of how financial performance contributes to bookings, revenue, and margin in the services business
  • Experience leading a growing organization
  • Proven experience building excellent client relationships, leading customer-facing teams to delivery services that add value
  • Strong influence and negotiation skills
  • Self-motivated
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and presentation skills to build and to deliver presentations to internal audiences and customer audiences that include Sr. Executives
  • Superb organizational skills - planning, directing, risk identification, risk management, risk mitigation, execution, coaching others
  • "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to deliver on organization goals and to be invested in the development of the broader services organization and the services delivery team
  • Travel requirements - 25-30%
Additional Information
The Team
Our Technical Customer Support team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you will be involved in implementing new products support strategies, managing customer escalations, interlocking with key stakeholders and ensuring enablement plans are in place for product portfolio expansion. We fix and identify technical problems, with a pointed focus on providing the best customer support in the industry.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We embrace diversity in thought and contribution and are committed to providing an equitable work environment that is foundational to our core values as a company and is vital to our success.

Job Summary

Help us bring people and businesses together
Our SaaS platform enables multi-location brands and businesses to boost their online presence in a rapidly evolving world. From big to small, from Adidas to ZenPark, our client base contains some of your favourite brands as well, we bet.
The Past, Present & Future
The Past: Founded in 2013 by David Federhen and Florian Hübner, two longtime friends with a vision to improve customer experience across the online and offline worlds, they created a platform that connected companies with local customers in the digital-first moment.
The Present: We're on a mission to put every single business on the map , and believe every business deserves success, regardless of size or location. Simply put, our location marketing platform exists to help our customers get found online and connect with customers through search, discovery, engagement and conversion.
The Future: We're a growing company with a bright future. We have established ourselves as a rising thought leader through the introduction of Location Performance Optimization (LPO). Our AI strategy is gaining momentum and it's setting us apart in the market. Our agentic AI 'UB-I' moves us from features and functions to business outcomes. UB-I will work 24/7 to optimize location performance, driving engagement, visibility and, most importantly, measurable results. As AI changes search far beyond traditional SEO results, we are at the forefront of enabling our customers to reach theirs in this new era. We have a passionate and diverse team, a comprehensive, intuitive platform and a clear vision for the future. We're looking for talented, passionate people, with an AI-first mindset, (like you ) to join us on our journey.
You and us
We are more than 400 Uberallers, with 50+ different nationalities in 30+ countries, who live and breathe our core values:
GROW TOGETHER
DEMONSTRATE PASSION & PERFORMANCE
BE BOLD & DRIVE CHANGE
BE CUSTOMER OBSESSED
So, what are you waiting for? If you're passionate, driven, customer obsessed and ready to be bold, we want you on our team! Apply now and let's grow together.
About The Role
We are looking for a proactive and skilled DevOps Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience to join our growing engineering team. You'll be working closely with a small team of four engineers to build, maintain, and scale our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and observability stack. We value collaboration, strong communication, and a growth mindset: you'll be expected to contribute ideas, give and receive feedback, and work independently when needed.
Your Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS, with a strong focus on EC2, RDS, OpenSearch, and EKS.
  • Manage the Kubernetes clusters running our microservices (we have over a hundred in production) as well as the legacy EC2-based platform.
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and Ansible.
  • Improve and develop our observability stack.
  • Collaborate closely with developers and other team members to ensure smooth CI/CD and release processes.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and optimization in deployment and infrastructure management.
  • Document processes, infrastructure, and decisions clearly and effectively.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response when required.
Your Profile
  • 5+ years of experience in a DevOps or similar role.
  • Deep experience with AWS services, especially EC2, RDS, EKS, and OpenSearch.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Kubernetes and related tooling (we use Helm, Kustomize and FluxCD, but we value knowing and adhering to the GitOps practices more than the specific tools).
  • Strong proficiency in Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure automation.
  • Database knowledge (MySQL and PostgreSQL)
  • Familiarity with observability tools like Prometheus, Thanos, Sentry, Loki, Grafana, and ElasticSearch.
  • Experience in CI/CD tools.
  • Bash or other shell scripting knowledge
  • Nice-to-have: Experience with GitLab CI and GitLab in general.
  • Nice-to-have: Familiarity with the JVM.
  • Nice-to-have: Experience in cost optimization on AWS.
  • Nice-to-have: Exposure to compliance/security best practices in DevOps.
  • Nice-to-have: Having worked with Istio or other service meshes.
Your Soft Skills & Mindset
  • Highly proactive and self-motivated; able to identify and address issues before they escalate.
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written. We are a remote and distributed team, so we focus on effective and asynchronous communication.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively within a distributed team, but also capable of driving tasks independently.
  • Open to giving and receiving feedback, and eager to grow with the team.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work.
What we offer:
 A mission with meaning and purpose At Uberall, we foster genuine connections between local businesses and people. Our diverse team allows us to win together with our partners, co-workers, and customers. Speaking of our customers, they’re some of the most recognizable businesses in the world.
A truly human culture We’re famous for our culture. Uberallers live by our values. We’re open, collaborative risk-takers with a whole lot of passion and grit.
️ Flexibility to fit your lifestyle Want to come to an office for collaboration? We’ve got space for you in Berlin, Amsterdam, and Barcelona. We also offer co-working access in Montreal, Paris, London, LA and San Diego. Prefer to work remotely? Fine by us! Bonus points if we meet your pets in a video call. If working from another country is legally possible for you and within a reasonable time zone, we happily support work-ations.
A piece of the pie Our pay & perks are competitive, and you better believe we review them on the regular to make sure they stay that way. We grow together, so of course all Uberallers are part of our long-term incentive program through VSOP/ESOP.
♺ Emotional and intellectual connection Events and alignment sessions - YES and YES. With the team, cross-functions, regional, you name it - we love bringing people together. Uberallers share a LOT of hobbies. Whatever you’re into – reading books, baking, heavy metal, fostering kittens . . you’ll find kindred spirits on our team.
Health and Wellness We prioritize your wellness with generous holiday time, paid parental and circumstantial leave, and individualized health and wellness opportunities depending on your location.
️ All-access pass Get immersed in Uberall from day one. Your onboarding is packed with a deep dive into our values, insights into all our departments and a chance to ask the CEO anything. We come together monthly for our town hall and product showroom so you’re always in the know.
Everyday growth We support you on your non-stop learning journey. We offer development dialogues, live workshops on topics like resilience and feedback and a Leadership Academy to make sure our leaders have all the tools to bring out the very best in teams. We also invest in your growth with a learning fund program reinforcing our commitment to fostering a culture of continuous learning.
Top-of-the-line tech MacBook Pro, magic mouse, 2nd screen . . Need anything else? Let the People & Culture team know.
Remember our "Grow Together " value from the beginning of the ad?
We mean it.

Everything starts with getting in touch. The best way to express your interest is by applying online. One of our real, human TA Partners will be carefully reading your profile and can't wait to hear from you.
In the meantime, let our "Uberall" social account give you some real-life impressions.
Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging:
At Uberall, we believe inclusion unlocks the potential of diversity. It’s right there in our number one core value – Grow Together. Sure, we’re over 400 unique people with over 50 nationalities working in 30 different countries, but we’re all Uberallers. That means we’re collaborative, open-minded and assume positive intent in everything we do. We don’t judge, and we don’t exclude.
Our flexible ways of working are designed to make sure each and every Uberaller belongs and thrives, no matter their background, abilities, or lifestyle. We don’t just think inclusion makes us stronger, we KNOW it.

title: Procurement Director
description:
Overview

Somos PepsiCo

Junte-se à PepsiCo e Ouse Transformar! Somos o lugar perfeito para pessoas curiosas, pensadoras e agentes de mudança. Desde o frontline até a nossa liderança, estamos entusiasmados com o futuro e trabalhamos em equipe para tornar o mundo um lugar melhor.

Fazer parte da PepsiCo significa fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de alimentos e bebidas do mundo, com nossas marcas icônicas sendo consumidas mais de um bilhão de vezes por dia em mais de 200 países. No Brasil desde 1953, a PepsiCo possui marcas reconhecidas como QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI e muitas outras.

Uma carreira na PepsiCo significa trabalhar em uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. Aqui, você pode ousar ser você. Não importa quem você seja, de onde você venha ou quem você ame, você sempre pode influenciar as pessoas ao seu redor e causar um impacto positivo no mundo.

Conheça um pouco mais sobre a PepsiCo: PepsiCoJobs

Responsibilities

A oportunidade

  • O objetivo principal deste novo papel é fortalecer a participação do Procurement como um verdadeiro parceiro de negócios, com uma equipe de papel estratégico mais sênior, capaz de desenhar e influenciar a estratégia do negócio com base em experiências profissionais, insights de categorias e mercado. Definir programas de SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) para garantir produtividade, inovação, eficiências de ponta a ponta e metas PEP+.

O seu impacto

• Gerenciar a equipe de Estratégia e Excelência em Procurement, fornecendo orientação e conhecimento aos subordinados e equipes intersetoriais para garantir alinhamento entre a estratégia da PepsiCo Brasil Foods e as categorias de Procurement.

• Supervisionar resultados de fóruns específicos de gestão de produtos/inovação, esforços ESG e DTV.

• Atuar como parceiro estratégico ao MSO (Market Supply Officer) na definição de estratégias, com visão holística dos objetivos estratégicos do negócio e suas implicações em procurement.

• Analisar e fornecer uma visão crítica sobre discussões e análises de revisão de negócios de ponta a ponta do MSO Foods & Salty.

• Garantir que a jornada de Transformação Digital seja executada rapidamente e mantida.

• Responsável pela governança de ponta a ponta (exemplo: conformidade de contratos, produtividade e outros KPIs chave) e programas de desenvolvimento de equipe/talentos, co-liderados com Recursos Humanos.

• Liderar análise de dados e gestão holística de custos.

• Apoiar a seleção de pessoal-chave para a equipe, em alinhamento com RH e MSO.

• Liderar uma equipe na qual irá treinar e desenvolver talentos, criando planos de sucessão a nível local e regional.

• Apoiar a definição de metas e KPIs do time de Procurement Brasil.

• Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe para alcançar alto desempenho.

Qualifications

Quem estamos buscando?

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Finanças, Economia ou áreas relacionadas.
  • MBA ou especialização em tópicos de Procurement é preferencial.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em gerenciamento de categorias de Procurement na indústria de bens de consumo.
  • Mais de 5 anos em cargos de liderança em gerenciamento de categorias em grandes empresas (gasto de USD 0,5B).
  • Experiência em inovação, governança e gestão de excelência em procurement.
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito).
  • Capacidade de navegar em frameworks legais/contratuais relevantes para procurement.
  • Habilidades avançadas em Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook.
  • Sólido entendimento de mecânica de cadeia de suprimentos, previsão e custeio.
  • Bom entendimento de análise financeira e modelagem de custos.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais, de execução e negociação.
  • Habilidades interpessoais para trabalhar efetivamente em equipe e influenciar todos os níveis.
  • Disposição para liderar mudanças e apoiar uma organização de classe mundial.
  • Busca por resultados, criatividade, colaboração e capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão.

Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando do seu bem-estar integral. Oferecemos:

  • Remuneração competitiva com componentes fixos e variáveis.
  • Programa de flexibilidade para equilibrar vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico.
  • Auto Executivo com opção de carro ou bônus de auxílio transporte.
  • Programas de bem-estar físico, mental e financeiro ao longo do ano.
  • Reconhecimento por tempo de serviço, comportamentos e liderança.
  • Benefícios familiares, como linhas de bem-estar, convênios, bolsas de estudo e auxílios.

Na PepsiCo, promovemos uma equipe diversa, colaborativa, equitativa e inclusiva, com oportunidades iguais para todos, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Job Description

Como Solution Manager de Controlling, você será responsável por garantir a implementação adequada dos processos de negócios relacionados aos impostos em nossos sistemas de back office e ferramentas de trading.

Neste papel, você garantirá que sua solução evolua, incluindo gerenciamento de solicitações de melhorias e priorização junto ao negócio. Do ponto de vista de suporte, você garantirá que o suporte nível 1 e 2 seja adequadamente tratado e entregará suporte nível 3 (melhorias e personalizações para novos países). Você será responsável pela gestão geral de incidentes da sua solução. Participará de qualquer implementação que envolva sua solução e gerenciará dependências com outras soluções. Manterá contato externo com o desenvolvimento da solução e atuará como consultor interno.

Você terá três papéis principais, cobrindo uma ampla gama de responsabilidades:

Fazer parte de nossa equipe de alta expertise, que deve:

The IT Compliance & Application Security Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating IT compliance initiatives, with a strong focus on Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and cybersecurity requirements. This position plays a critical role in identifying risks, implementing cybersecurity best practices, and maintaining a robust control environment across both financial and non-financial systems.

Key Responsibilities:

Control Framework Ownership Develop and maintain application-specific control matrices (e.g., SoD, secure development, identity lifecycle, privileged access). Ensure alignment with frameworks such as COSO, COBIT, and NIST.

Policy Implementation & Oversight Translate enterprise security policies into actionable control requirements. Ensure consistent implementation across centralized (e.g., SAP GRC) and decentralized platforms.

Partner with internal software development teams to promote secure coding practices and integrate security checkpoints within CI/CD pipelines.

IAM & SoD Governance Develop governance over identity provisioning, role design, and segregation of duties enforcement. Coordinate exceptions and remediation plans in collaboration with IAM and audit teams.

Education, and training, develop and train application and system owners on their responsibilities and self-assessment for security controls.

IT Controls & Frameworks Deep knowledge of ITGCs, application controls, and frameworks (COSO, COBIT, NIST). Experience in change management, access management, and system operations.

Audit Methodologies & Standards Familiarity with PCAOB, ISACA, and other audit standards. Experience working with internal/external auditors (Big Four experience is a plus).

Regulatory & Compliance Knowledge Strong understanding of SOX (especially Section 404), GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS.

GRC Tools Proficiency in SAP GRC and other GRC platforms for control monitoring and reporting.

Cybersecurity Fundamentals Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, incident response, and vulnerability management.

Data Analysis & Reporting Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and audit findings. Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools for reporting.

Communication: Clear articulation of technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Leadership & Influence: Ability to drive compliance initiatives and gain organizational buy-in.

Adaptability: Flexibility in navigating regulatory and technological changes.

Strategic Thinking: Alignment of compliance efforts with business objectives.

Proactive Mindset: Anticipation of risks and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in IT compliance, audit, or cybersecurity roles.

This hybrid position will be located at the Siemens Energy facility located in Olean, NY ; Painted Post, NY; or Bethlehem, PA depending on candidate’s skill/experience.
How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Prioritize safety by adhering to corporate/local procedures and completing safety training on time, while managing projects alongside the Product Design Team and ensuring timely approval for all processes.
  • Coordinate and participate in key meetings (kickoff, weekly status, scheduling) and workflows (SAP, Globus), driving process improvements and maintaining effective communication across all cross-functional teams.
  • Act as a first point of contact for technical issues, managing team expectations, and serving as a positive role model, with a focus on reviewing proposals to capture scope accurately and maintaining project hours.
  • Provide training and guidance to less experienced design team members, assist manufacturing, purchasing, and planning with drawing and materials list interpretations, and address shop issues related to drawings as needed.
  • Engage in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of design tools, product improvements, and standards for turbomachinery products, potentially assisting with interviewing and onboarding new team members.
  • Support the product line's success through collaboration with the solution development team on commercial offerings and performing miscellaneous duties as required.

What You Bring
  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent with 5+ years of experience in rotating machinery, or an Associate Degree in drafting with 10+ years of design drafting and industry experience. Those with more experience may be eligible for a more senior level.
  • Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail, ability to see the broader picture, and outstanding communication skills for effective collaboration across the organization.
  • Exhibits the capacity to independently manage complex projects while maintaining enthusiasm and intensity whether working individually or as part of a team.
  • Shows professionalism and tact in interactions at all levels, from management to clients, coupled with strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, advanced 2D/3D CAD, and familiar with ERP systems like SAP or Oracle, reflecting solid digital literacy.
  • Flexible and ready for domestic and international travel on short notice, anticipating about 5-15% travel requirement.

Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. Siemens Energy employees with current visa sponsorship may be eligible for internal transfers.

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. Atuamos desde a concepção e o desenho de soluções seguras, a análise de riscos e vulnerabilidades em arquiteturas existentes e propostas, até o acompanhamento do ciclo de vida das implementações de segurança, assegurando que os controles sejam eficazes e eficientes, em conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos de segurança e resiliência.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Data Fetching Team, which is responsible for building and maintaining the systems that collect public data from third-party sources. In this role, you'll contribute to the development and upkeep of reliable and compliant data ingestion pipelines that support key data flows across the company.

  • Build resilient systems that maintain high throughput within the allowed constraints of external sources.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Track changes in external data schemas (e.g. response format updates) and adjust collection logic as needed.

We offer
In Vilomix our foundation is built on collaboration, and we have a fundamental belief that we are stronger together. We thus offer a workplace where we develop together – across departments, competencies and national borders. Employees are our most important resource, and we make an effort to create the best environment for well-being, development and influence.

Vilomix is a part of Danish Agro Group. At Vilomix we deliver vitamin- and mineral solutions combined with innovative feed additives to ensure the best results in our customers animal production. All solutions are based on strong animal nutrition know-how. Besides strong premix solutions we also provide high quality concentrates, milk replacers and hygiene products for farmers and feed industry. Na Performa, o Delivery é peça-chave para garantir que nossos projetos sejam executados com excelência, alinhando as expectativas do cliente com a entrega de alto valor. Essa pessoa atua como um facilitador entre os times de desenvolvimento, gestão e stakeholders, garantindo que os objetivos sejam cumpridos dentro do prazo e qualidade esperados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Delivery Manager será responsável por planejar, executar e monitorar projetos de tecnologia, utilizando metodologias ágeis e tradicionais. O profissional atuará como ponto focal entre as equipes de desenvolvimento, stakeholders e clientes, garantindo a entrega de projetos dentro do prazo, orçamento e qualidade esperados.
Planejamento e Execução de Projetos:

  • Definir o escopo, cronograma e orçamento dos projetos.

Gerenciamento de Equipe e Stakeholders:
  • Liderar e motivar a equipe do projeto, promovendo a colaboração e comunicação eficaz.
  • Gerenciar a comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos, mantendo-os informados sobre o progresso do projeto.
  • Resolver conflitos e problemas que possam surgir durante o ciclo de vida do projeto.

Monitoramento e Controle:
  • Acompanhar o progresso do projeto, identificando e mitigando riscos.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas do projeto, realizando testes e revisões.
  • Monitorar o orçamento e cronograma do projeto, realizando ajustes quando necessário.
  • Gerar relatórios de desempenho e apresentar os resultados para stakeholders internos e externos.
Melhoria Contínua:
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos do time.
  • Implementar práticas ágeis e tradicionais para otimizar a eficiência e eficácia dos projetos.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as últimas tendências e melhores práticas em gerenciamento de projetos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Certificação PMP, SAFe ou Scrum Master (desejável).
  • Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de projetos de tecnologia, utilizando metodologias ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos (Jira, MS Project, etc.).
  • Habilidades de liderança, comunicação e negociação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e de forma independente.
  • Orientação para resultados e capacidade de resolução de problemas.
  • Parceria com escolas de Inglês e espanhol
  • ️ Descanso Remunerado

Sobre a empresa

Somos especialistas emTransformação Digital ,trabalhamos como parceiros de nossos clientes, atuando desde a identificação do problema, compreendendo quais suas reais necessidades, até a sustentação da solução desenvolvida.
Atuamos com o desenvolvimento das melhoressoluções em estratégia digital ,engenharia de software ,otimização de processos eexperiência do cliente , priorizando entregas comresultados de curto prazo ediferencial competitivo , apoiando nossos clientes a atingir uma meta, resolver um problema ou satisfazer uma necessidade.
Nossa cultura favorece e promove a colaboração, a agilidade e a criatividade. Vivenciamos e valorizamos a entrega de resultados e não o controle e vigilância excessiva, através da nossa cultura de confiança, propiciamos autonomia a todos os profissionais.

At EBANX, you’ll help expand access to payments and technology in some of the world’s most dynamic markets. We’re a unicorn-status fintech , AI-powered , and scaling fast across 29 countries and counting .

Our platform connects leading global companies to more than 1 billion consumers , enabling seamless cross-border payments where it matters most. We build with purpose, move with speed, and create solutions that are both innovative and inclusive.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that’s transforming the future of payments with clarity , ambition , and real-world impact — we’d love to meet you.

In the Product team, we’re responsible for creating solutions that deliver real value to our customers and the business. We combine strategic vision, user focus, and cross-team collaboration to build innovative, scalable products aligned with EBANX’s goals.

As aProduct Manager you will be responsible for the strategy, performance, and evolution of EBANX’s local payment solutions in the Cono Sur region. You will act as the owner of the product — defining its vision, driving its adoption, and ensuring its success in the market. This is a high-impact role that combines product strategy, commercial alignment, discovery, and delivery execution.

You'll lead the expansion and optimization of our local payment solutions in Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Bolivia, connecting the dots between merchant needs, business priorities, and market opportunities.   • Lead product discoveries to deeply understand customer pain points, competitive landscape, and opportunities for innovation;
  • Partner with commercial, operations, finance, marketing, legal and engineering to develop and deliver scalable, compliant and high-impact solutions;
  • Manage the full product lifecycle — from ideation and discovery to go-to-market, enablement, and post-launch iteration;
  • Develop the go-to-market strategy for new features or payment methods, including training, positioning, and performance tracking;
  • Monitor product performance (TPV, revenue, costs, margins) and identify levers for growth, optimization, and differentiation;
  • Build business cases to prioritize initiatives and support strategic decision-making;

Must-haves to shine in this role:

  • Proven experience inproduct management or product strategy , ideally inpayments, fintech, or high-growth tech companies ;
  • Solid understanding of thepayment ecosystem (issuers, acquirers, APMs, schemes, PSPs, settlement, FX, regulations);
  • Strong business acumen — ability to connect product decisions to revenue, cost efficiency, and market impact;
  • Fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese is a plus;
  • Experience working cross-functionally in a global and multicultural environment;
  • Hands-on experience with product discovery, market research, stakeholder alignment, and backlog management;
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to drive consensus and influence across teams;

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience leading local payment strategy in Latin American markets, especially in the Cono Sur region;
  • Deep knowledge of payments ecosystem in LATAM;
  • Ability to translate complexity into clarity — whether in a sales pitch, a product doc, or a roadmap update;
  • Track record of successfully launching and scaling payment solutions;
  • Passion for digital commerce, innovation, and building products that solve real merchant problems;

EBANX offers:

  • Performance Bonus: Annual bonus program based on company results.
  • Meal Allowance: Monthly allowance to support your meals.
  • EBANX Education: Financial assistance for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs to support your professional growth.
  • EBANX Skills: Dedicated budget for courses, certifications, and workshops to encourage continuous learning.
  • Language Classes: Language classes to support your personal and professional development.
  • Health & Well-being: Medical and dental plans with extensive coverage, including support for dependents and wellness programs.
    Flexible Work Culture: Semi-flexible hours, additional day off on your birthday, and year-end break to support work-life balance.
  • Well-being Program: Access to activities and resources that promote physical and mental health.

Description
Job Title: Senior Manufacturing Programs Engineer
(Alternative titles: Manufacturing Launch Manager, Product Industrialization Lead, or Manufacturing Integration & Quoting Specialist )
Job Summary
Tyber Medical is seeking a skilled and experienced professional to lead the manufacturing integration and quoting process for new product introductions. This role serves as a critical interface between R&D, production, and business functions, ensuring that products are designed for manufacturability and launched efficiently across our manufacturing sites. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise in manufacturing with strong cross-functional collaboration and business acumen.
Location
This role may be based at any of Tyber Medical’s U.S. facilities:

  • Bethlehem, Pennsylvania
  • Athens, Alabama
  • Marquette, Michigan
  • Bonita Springs, Florida
Reporting Line
Reports to the Director of Strategic Development
Key Responsibilities
Primary Responsibilities
  • Collaborate with R&D to create manufacturing assumptions during the product development and quoting phases.
  • Review final engineering drawings for manufacturability and implement Design for Manufacturing (DFM) practices.
  • Lead and facilitate the transfer of designs into scalable, efficient manufacturing production.
  • Ensure programs launch on time, cost-effectively, and according to initial quoting assumptions.
  • Present cost models, quote status, and rationale to internal stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Support quoting activities across multiple Tyber Medical manufacturing sites.
  • Promote continuous improvement in processes, workflows, and interdepartmental collaboration.
  • Consolidate and communicate key inputs to inform operational and business decision-making.
  • Ensure all development activities comply with Tyber Medical’s quality system.
Secondary Responsibilities
  • Assist in business development by supporting technical feasibility and cost evaluations.
  • Identify and implement process and technology improvements for launched programs to enhance performance and cost-efficiency.
Experience & Qualifications
  • At least 10 years of experience in manufacturing development, industrial engineering, or related roles.
  • Proven success in bringing new products into full-scale production.
  • Deep understanding of quoting, cost modeling, and DFM principles.
  • Experience managing or contributing to cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with regulated manufacturing environments (e.g., medical device, aerospace, or automotive) preferred.
Education
  • Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent work experience
Skills & Capabilities
  • Advanced Excel skills for cost modeling and data analysis
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks or similar CAD/CAM tools
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong interpersonal and communication abilities across technical and executive teams
  • Self-motivated with a structured and organized approach to program management

description:

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Sales Engineer (Entry-Level) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Ubuntu Pro Sales Engineer to help global companies embrace the latest and greatest Linux and open source applications. Our team applies expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu Pro, OpenStack and Canonical Microcloud, Kubernetes and a wide range of associated technology. The people who love this role are software engineers who enjoy customer conversations and solving customer problems during the presales cycle. Ubuntu is used by pretty much every enterprise in the world, in every industry. This is a fantastic opportunity to learn about the open source technology landscape and develop your business technology insights. You will see first hand in various industries how Linux - and Ubuntu in particular - is shaping innovation and changing the world for the better.
This role is particularly suited to candidates with a technical background who are business minded and driven by commercial success. This role is on our global Field Engineering team and will work closely with enterprise sales leads.
Location: Most of our colleagues work from home. We are growing teams in EMEA, Americas and APAC time zones, so can accommodate candidates from almost any country.
What your day will look like
The Ubuntu Pro Sales Engineer is a key player in our efforts to facilitate and drive the adoption of Ubuntu Pro in the very large Ubuntu enterprise user base.

  • Collect customer business requirements and advise them on Ubuntu and relevant open source applications
  • Identify customer challenges with open source and articulate how Ubuntu Pro could help solve them
  • Deliver presentations and demonstrations of Ubuntu Pro to prospective and current clients
  • Liaise with product teams to give them feedback on requirements to influence roadmap
  • Work collaboratively with your sales team to reach our common targets
  • Global travel up to 25% of time for internal and external events and 25% to customer meetings
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Demonstrated personal interest in continuous learning and development
  • Practical knowledge of Linux, virtualisation, containers and networking
  • Business-minded technology thinker and problem solver
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & leaders, such as Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP
  • Interest in large-scale enterprise open source - private clouds, machine learning and AI, data and analytics
  • Intermediate level Python programming skills
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • A dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to follow up and meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally, for company events up to two weeks long, and customer or industry meetings
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
