Join to apply for the Procurement Project Manager role at Thales

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.
Procurement Project Manager
This position is hybrid model in our São Bernardo do Campo unit.
Position Summary
The Procurement Project Manager (PPM) is responsible to provide efficient and cost-effective value-added purchasing support. Within the Global Business Unit (GBU), the PPM is responsible for supporting procurement activity that are part of a bid, project or product delivery. Within the integrated team, the PPM represents and promotes the Procurement organization. In their role, the PPM provides the best procurement solution (competitiveness, quality, on-time delivery), fulfilling the customer needs and aligned with Thales procurement strategy led by the Global Category Managers (GCM). To this end, and to introduce supplier innovations to our solutions, the PPM plays a key role in the early stages of bids, projects and/or product/service delivery activities. This role is key to a major FAA project and setting up the supply chain and industrial solution with the Category Managers.
Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Develop and maintain the project procurement strategy using input from customer’s tender and prime contract documents, from the project management plan and project schedule from Project Management, project design documentation from Engineering, proposal documents from Marketing, and project financial data from Finance;
  • Challenge the acquisition needs and requirements and to promote design to cost analysis with the suppliers, during the definition phase of the solution, in order to increase the competitiveness of the solution;
  • Create work packages, including all required information to enable an RFQ/RFP (statement of work, delivery schedules, budget, etc.),
  • Assign work packages to relevant Category Manger / Category Buyer
  • Manage the development of the supply chain architecture to meet needs of the project with support from Regional and Global Category Management
  • Optimize supply chain costs early in the life cycle ensuring savings are achieved against budget;
  • Play a key role in defining and implementing strategies to meet U.S. Federal Procurement requirements including offsets, “Buy America” and Small Disadvantaged Business;
  • Work closely with stakeholders including Project Management, Engineering, Marketing and Finance to ensure the procurement strategy is communicated and well understood;
  • Support the flow of information with Project Management through regular reporting on the status of procurement activity - achievements, issues and goals;
  • Monitor project material costs and report deviations against the established project baseline;
  • Play a key role in Make or Buy analysis;
  • Contribute to Post Mortem Analysis (lessons learned) and implement required changes to support the project.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor degree in a relevant field of study;
  • Procurement Management or ISM certifications;
  • Project Management certification;
  • Experience performing similar activities;
  • Track record of success in a similar role in a relevant business or market;
  • Strong communication skills, written and verbal;
  • Excellent organization skills;
  • Project management - planning, time management, problem solving, communication and teamwork;
  • Interpersonal skills - ability to excel working in cross-functional teams;
  • Ability to prioritize tasks while meeting deadlines in a high-pressure environment;
  • Ability to influence in order to deliver business results.

If you’re excited about working with Thales, but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community!
What We Offer
Thales provides an extensive benefits program for all full-time employees working 30 or more hours per week and their eligible dependents, including the following:
  • Elective Health and Dental plans.
  • Retirement Savings Plan with a company contribution and a match.
  • Company paid holidays, vacation days, and paid sick leave.
  • Company provided Life Insurance.

title: Full Stack Developer – React.js + Node.js (GCP & AI Integration)
description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role :

We are looking for a skilledFull Stack Developer who can take full ownership of application development, deployment, and optimization. You will lead the migration of an existing Elixir/Phoenix-based application into a modern React + Node.js stack.

This is a hands-on engineering role that requires technical leadership, autonomy, and a strong understanding of cloud-based deployment and AI integration.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead the migration of an existing platform from Elixir/Phoenix to React + Node.js + PostgreSQL.
  • Build scalable, user-friendly front-end applications using React.js .
  • Develop robust backend services using Node.js (Express, Nest, or an equivalent framework).
  • Integrate with AI services such as OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini for advanced product capabilities.
  • Deploy applications using GCP and manage infrastructure (CI/CD, hosting, environment setup).
  • Work with both SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL and Firestore.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure best practices in full-stack architecture and deployment.

Sobre nosso cliente

A posição terá papel estratégico na interface entre o time financeiro e a área comercial, garantindo que nossas soluções estejam alinhadas às necessidades de nossos clientes e canais, principalmente no que diz respeito a financiamentos via bancos, CPR, barter e outras ferramentas do mercado agro.

* Vivência no relacionamento e negociação com bancos, fintechs, cooperativas de crédito e órgãos de fomento;
* Forte capacidade de análise, visão estratégica, senso de urgência e atuação prática ("mão na massa");
* Habilidade de comunicação, liderança e trabalho em equipe;
* Inglês avançado ou fluente, essencial para interações com a matriz e relatórios internacionais;

* Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, incluindo salário fixo, bônus e benefícios;

Job type: Full-time employee

Você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? Aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de vendas . Buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

Quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? Vem pra FARM!

  • Atendimento consultivo à cliente;
  • Ser guardiã da experiência em loja, propagando a cultura da marca;
  • Acompanhar de forma proativa toda a jornada do cliente na loja, desde a entrada até a saída, garantindo uma experiência de compra diferenciada;
  • Foco na fidelização e realização do pós-venda (através da ferramenta Dito), mantendo nossas clientes sempre apaixonadas;
  • Gerenciar suas próprias vendas e entregas, assegurando a eficiência;
  • Impulsionar as vendas digitais, promovendo o código de vendedora e utilizando redes sociais, com foco em criar engajamento e gerar encantamento em cada interação;
  • Manter o ambiente da loja organizado, seguindo os padrões de VM e produção de moda;
  • Realizar o registro das vendas de pagamento digital, através da ferramenta Somabox, garantindo uma experiência de pagamento ágil e segura;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, com um espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • Facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • Interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • Domínio de ferramentas digitais e redes sociais, essenciais para uma marca que conecta o físico e o digital;
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Flexibilidade de horário.

Quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • Para garantir o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:

Wellhub (antigo Gympass);

Assistência médica e odontológica com coparticipação;

Zenklub (duas sessões gratuitas por mês para consultas com profissionais de saúde, incluindo psicólogos e nutricionistas);

Política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais

  • Day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
  • E a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo SOMA.

Nosso percurso

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo. A nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. O que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

Em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. De Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. E seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We're seeking a Middle Project Manager to focus on the implementation of a CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) solution.
Our clients are major enterprises in the automotive, travel, and financial services sectors, serving a vast member base across the US.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and manage risks to ensure on-time delivery.
  • Lead and motivate the project team, coordinating their efforts to keep them on track for deliverables.
  • Develop and maintain strong business relationships.
  • Act as the point of contact and communicate project status to all participants; plan meetings and take minutes.
  • Cooperate and coordinate with other departments and third-party subcontractors, meeting the needs of different stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience in project management.
  • Experience in managing projects with vendors, including scope-based projects (fixed priced).
  • Experience with Contact Center Solutions is preferred.
  • Business analytics skills.
  • In-depth experience with identifying and understanding user and business needs.
  • Master's or Bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, Excel (pivot tables, data analysis), PowerPoint, and Visio.
  • Excellent self-management, planning, organizational, presentation, and analytical skills.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Upper-Intermediate or higher English.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural team.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance : join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits : enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance,and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture : make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset : reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact : collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.

title: Commercial Director
description:
Ten Group is the global leader in lifestyle and travel services. Since 1998, our personalized, world-class, and expert service has enabled world-renowned companies to achieve maximum customer satisfaction and retention. Today, we work with more than 50 global companies and serve millions of customers in over 52 countries from 22 select locations in major financial capitals worldwide.

For more information, check out our Welcome to Ten video!

We are entering an exciting new chapter in Brazil: bringing on visionary, market-specific leadership to unlock the next wave of growth. With strong foundations already in place, the opportunity is huge to deepen relationships with existing clients, win new ones, and expand our supplier network in one of our most strategic markets.

We are looking for a dynamic and entrepreneurial Strategic Account Director to join the team in Brazil. This pivotal brand-new role will combine strategic account management, business development, and go-to-market leadership.

In this role, you will be responsible for optimising and deepening relationships with our key clients, identifying and leading new growth opportunities, and shaping our market expansion strategies in Brazil.

Acting as a strategic interface between proposition, service, product, and marketing teams, you will ensure that Ten’s global concierge and lifestyle offerings are compellingly packaged for the Brazilian market and aligned with what truly resonates with our members. You will work closely with the local and regional Client Services team to develop client strategy, market intelligence, and Proposition localization to ensure we grow sustainably in Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Leadership:

    • Identify, assess, and lead new business opportunities within existing client accounts.
    • Develop account growth plans and drive cross-selling and upselling initiatives

Client Relationship Management:

    • Serve as the senior point of contact for key client accounts, ensuring high levels of satisfaction, maintaining our extraordinarily high account retention and growing active members, profits and revenues. Proactively address client needs and resolve issues to build trust and long-term partnerships.
    • Define what "success" looks like from a corporate client's perspective and align internal metrics to demonstrate that value clearly internally and externally.
    • Collaborate with Client Services and Proposition teams to build a consistent, ROI-driven story for client reporting and renewals.
    • Act as a strategic counterpart—not a day-to-day operational or client services account lead—in client conversations, helping to shape future partnerships and investments.

Go-to-Market Strategy:

    • Analyse the Brazilian market to define product/market fit and inform our local go-to-market approach.
    • Collaborate with Proposition, Product and Marketing teams to tailor offerings for the region.

Solution Packaging & Pitching:

  • Develop compelling product packages and marketing materials tailored to client needs.
  • Lead client presentations and pitches, articulating our value proposition and securing buy-in.

Market Intelligence:
Stay abreast of market trends, competitor activities, and client feedback to inform strategy and drive continuous improvement.

Essential requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B sales, preferably within the advertising or loyalty industry
  • Strong background in executive-level engagement
  • Proven track record of managing and growing key client accounts
  • Experience using data and insights to showcase ROI and business value to clients
  • Deep understanding of the Brazilian market and business culture
  • Innovative thinker with a talent for generating fresh ideas that open new opportunities, combined with strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English

Preferred requirements:

  • Fluent in Spanish, with experience selling across LATAM countries

For a Spanish speaker who will be covering Brazil as well as other LATAM countries, expected travel will be approximately once every 2 months, between 6 to 8 trips per year.

This is a hybrid role located in Sao Paulo. We are looking for someone who can work from the office 3 days a week.

Guidelines for Hybrid work:

  • Located in Sao Paulo
  • Please note that if you live within a commutable distance of the office, you will be asked to enter into a hybrid working arrangement, with up to 60% Home Office possibility.
  • A secure home office at your confirmed address, free from background noise or other distractions
  • Internet service must meet minimum requirements and minimum speed check must be completed

Our people are at the heart of the business, and we have a culture of recognition and reward - both through regular appraisals but also annual Extra Mile Awards where we celebrate those who have gone that extra mile in their role. We also encourage all our staff to incorporate their aspirations and interests into their career at Ten and we are there every step of the way in supporting development.

  • A competitive Brazilian Real package made of a base salary + sales commission
  • Paid time away from work. Our employees enjoy a competitive paid time off package, including a day each year to volunteer time for a good cause that is important to you.

  • Extra Rewards . Lucrative Ten Loyalty Rewards program.

Join to apply for the Senior Sales Engineer role at Infinite Lambda

The Senior Sales Engineer role at Infinite Lambda is designed for a technical leader who bridges sales and engineering, driving growth in a fast-growing consultancy focused on data and AI solutions. This position is crucial for engaging clients, shaping sales strategies, and expanding into new markets.
The position is titled Senior Sales Engineer , reporting directly to the General Manager, US, and is situated within the Global Sales Organization. This leadership role is critical for aligning technical expertise with sales objectives, ensuring Infinite Lambda’s solutions meet client needs effectively.
LOCATION & WORK ARRANGEMENT
The role is remote, but you will be expected to travel to client sites and occasionally for in-person Infinite Lambda meetings. You will be covering both South America and the US, offering flexibility to work remotely and onsite as needed.
Detailed Responsibilities
PROSPECTIVE CLIENT ENGAGEMENT

  • Initiate and manage engagements with prospective clients from the early stages of the sales process, ensuring a strong start to the sales cycle;
  • Understand and document client needs, articulating how Infinite Lambda’s products and services can address these needs effectively;
  • Collaborate with the sales team to drive a collaborative approach, creating compelling proposals that align with client expectations;
  • Conduct and facilitate technical deep-dive workshops with prospective clients to showcase capabilities and gather insights, using workshop outputs to strengthen proposals;
  • Identify relevant Infinite Lambda products and services, working with the sales team to position them strategically for each opportunity;
  • Assist both the sales and delivery teams in estimating project scope, effort, and resources, producing realistic and commercially viable account strategies. This includes defining initial team composition, tools to utilise, and a high-level roadmap.
LEAD SALES ENGINEER STRATEGY
  • Work with departments such as Product & Services, Customer Success, and Sales & Partnerships to clearly define roles and responsibilities, ensuring seamless collaboration across functions;
  • Collaborate with Product & Services to stay informed about existing offerings and influence product roadmaps, helping design new products and services based on client feedback and market trends;
  • Enhance the positioning of Infinite Lambda’s products and services during the sales process and beyond, improving how value is communicated to clients;
  • Liaise with senior leadership (CEO, CTO, CPO, COO, CSO) at Infinite Lambda to formulate a clear strategy for combining data and cloud expertise into a holistic value proposition, strengthening the company’s market positioning;
  • Conduct regular research on industry trends, working with leadership to evolve strategies as appropriate to maintain competitiveness;
  • Deepen subject-matter knowledge in Infinite Lambda’s key industry verticals, ensuring a strong understanding of client needs and market dynamics.
SOUTH AMERICA EXPANSION
  • Partner with Infinite Lambda’s executive team to identify and establish delivery hubs in South America, supporting the company’s growth strategy in the region;
  • Actively participate in hiring efforts for the new hubs, and be physically present onsite to help set up team culture, fostering a positive and collaborative environment. This responsibility is timeboxed or milestone-based, such as a fixed duration of 6 months or until the first 15 hires are onboarded, as mutually agreed;
  • Ensure the expansion aligns with Infinite Lambda’s mission and values, contributing to long-term success in the region.
Additional Duties
  • Work with Infinite Lambda’s executive team to help steer the company’s overall strategy in a positive direction, providing insights from sales engineering perspectives.
  • Represent Infinite Lambda at external conferences and events, promoting the company’s brand, thought leadership, and expertise in data and cloud engineering.
Requirements
  • Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is required; an advanced degree is preferred;
  • Experience: A proven track record in sales engineering or technical sales, preferably within the data, cloud, or technology sectors, with significant leadership experience;
  • Technical expertise: experience in data engineering, analytics engineering and data scientist roles and related technologies, such as AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, dbt and machine learning frameworks is essential;
  • Data architecture: Stream processing and batch data warehouse processing, event-driven architecture, micro services, DataOps and MLOps practices;
  • Communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business benefits for clients and stakeholders;
  • Leadership and strategy: Experience in leading sales engineering teams or functions, with a strategic mindset to influence company direction and market expansion;
  • Collaboration: Strong ability to work effectively across different departments and levels, fostering collaboration with Product & Services, Customer Success, and Sales & Partnerships;
  • Market expansion: Experience in international markets or expanding into new regions is a plus, particularly knowledge of South American markets and business practices, which is desirable for this role.

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Challenge and align technical decisions across disciplines that lead the project to success

What we're looking for

A technical leader who excels at giving feedback and has demonstrated capabilities in facilitating team success

Experience in shipping AAA titles across multiple platforms

Experience with the unique challenges of creating and maintaining large-scale, live, online multiplayer games, with a focus on advanced networking, real-time physics, and dynamic, interoperating services

Advanced C++ skills and experience with scripting languages, low-level debugging, and optimization

Impeccable problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

Experience collaborating with and managing relationships with both internal teams and external partners

Architecting and building solutions in multiple areas of expertise – Gameplay, Graphics, Audio, UI, Networking, and Physics

Passionate about personal development, taking advantage of opportunities to continuously improve

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

title: GERENTE SÊNIOR DE PRODUTO E OPERAÇÕES LOGÍSTICAS
description:
A AMARO é mais do que moda; somos a escolha assertiva da mulher brasileira para acompanhá-la em todos os seus melhores momentos. Com peças de qualidade, corte diferenciado, entrega super rápida e informação de moda relevante, temos clássicos que acompanham nossas clientes por toda a vida e lançamentos que trazem um novo olhar a cada estação.
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa estrategicamente orientada, com perfil analítico e experiência robusta em supply e sourcing, para assumir a posição de Gerente Sênior de Produto e Operações Logísticas na AMARO.
Essa posição será o elo central entre a criação e a execução: da definição dos volumes com o time de Estilo, passando pela produção com fornecedores até o recebimento dos produtos e sua entrega ao cliente final.
Embora inclua também a gestão logística (CD e transporte), o maior esforço e complexidade estarão no acompanhamento dos fluxos de produto e produção, exigindo familiaridade com o ciclo de desenvolvimento e entrega de coleções, múltiplos fornecedores e gestão de prioridades.
Seu dia a dia na Amaro:
Sourcing e Produto (foco principal):

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de produto: desde o alinhamento de volumes com o time de Estilo até a chegada dos itens no CD.
  • Acompanhar e garantir os prazos de produção com fornecedores nacionais e internacionais, atuando com controle rigoroso de lead times e entregas.
  • Coordenar o recebimento físico e sistêmico dos produtos no CD, garantindo acuracidade, qualidade e conformidade.
  • Ser a principal interface com os times de Estilo e Produto, garantindo fluidez na comunicação e antecipação de riscos de produção.
  • Otimizar o calendário de desenvolvimento e recebimento, visando o abastecimento saudável da operação e o cumprimento de metas comerciais.
  • Liderar rotinas de alinhamento de status com fornecedores, estilo e planejamento.
Logística:
  • Gerir o Centro de Distribuição e parceiros logísticos (3PL), assegurando eficiência nas operações de armazenagem, expedição e transporte.
  • Monitorar KPIs logísticos como SLA de entrega, acuracidade de estoque, giro de recebimento e lead time de transporte.
  • Trabalhar com Tech e Operações para promover melhorias de sistema e automações no fluxo logístico.
O que estamos buscando?
  • Experiência sênior em cargos de liderança nas áreas de supply chain, sourcing, logística ou operações de produto.
  • Vivência com fornecedores de moda e cadeia têxtil (nacional e/ou internacional), com domínio de processos de desenvolvimento e produção.
  • Experiência em gestão de recebimento, controle de prazos, interface com estilo e acompanhamento de entrega de coleções.
  • Sólida experiência com gestão de operações logísticas, especialmente CD e transporte via operadores 3PL.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado(a) a dados, com domínio de KPIs operacionais e de supply.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para lidar com múltiplos stakeholders.
Diferenciais que Amamos:
  • Experiência em empresas de moda, e-commerce, D2C ou startups.
O que oferecemos?
  • Benefícios flexíveis que não se limitam a mercado e restaurante e podem ser usados em apps de delivery, mobilidade, cultura e todos os estabelecimentos que aceitam a bandeira Mastercard.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica (opcional).
  • Convênio com farmácias.
  • Vale transporte ou Estacionamento.
  • Petloves - Assistência Médica para seu Pet.
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Descontos exclusivos AMARO.com
  • Totalpass & Classpass: sua saúde física é importante!
  • Convênio com o Sesc.
  • Posher: serviços de beleza e bem estar.

title: Director, Ecosystem Engineering
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

Join us in shaping the future of Fortnite — one of the world’s most influential interactive platforms. We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to drive the development of foundational systems that support the Fortnite experience at scale — including player onboarding, progression, identity, lobbies, and purchasing. These systems form the connective tissue of the Fortnite ecosystem, powering player interaction, progression, and seamless transitions between experiences. This role is central to our goal of delivering consistent, high-quality user experiences across internal and third-party content — while enabling scale, flexibility, and innovation for the entire platform.

In this role, you will

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Fortnite’s ecosystem systems, driving scalability, consistency, and platform evolution.
  • Lead development of features that span all Fortnite content, ensuring unified experiences and reliable scale across modes
  • Partner with internal teams (e.g., Battle Royale, LEGO Fortnite, new IPs) to ensure systems align with desired flows and player-facing requirements.
  • Collaborate with third-party developers to enable flexible, performant integration with Fortnite's shared systems.
  • Grow and lead a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation, inclusion, and engineering excellence.
  • Drive platform evolution while balancing stability, performance, and flexibility for diverse use cases.
  • Drive innovation and creative problem solving in areas that do not have an internal precedent

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience architecting and building user-facing systems in a live services or platform environment (e.g., menus, accounts, progression, commerce).
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend and client-service patterns, ideally in cross-platform or online service contexts.
  • Comfortable navigating complex user flows and dependencies across multiple teams and surfaces.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills with a track record of cross-functional collaboration.
  • Passion for building intuitive, reliable systems that support a wide range of player and developer needs.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

title: Key Account Manager - Brazil
description:
We are ODILO: a fast-growing edtech company, nominated three years in a row to be the next unicorn in the market, with a mission to democratize access to high-quality education and provide educational technology solutions to help our users reach their full potential.

Through our solutions, we provide access to millions of digital content items from the world's best providers and, using educational technology and Artificial Intelligence, enabling any organization to create its own unlimited learning ecosystem.

Currently, more than 4,500 institutions (governments, schools, libraries, universities, companies, and startups) place their trust in Odilo, providing access to their unlimited learning platforms to more than 170 million users in over 50 countries.

In 2022 we raised our latest Series C funding round (+60M€), strengthening our international presence and increasing our content catalogue. Our team is truly international (19+ nationalities) with the best talent across the education, media, content, and technology sectors.

Our mission and vision: empower everyone to become the best version of themselves by allowing any organization to provide unlimited learning in the most frictionless, efficient and valuable way.

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Key Account Manager to lead our commercial efforts in Brazil’s Public Sector and Education market, managing both existing client relationships and driving new business development. This role includes maintaining strategic accounts and opening new opportunities, working with customers like Secretarias Estaduais de Educação, municipal governments, universities, and public institutions, as well as coordination with partners to ensure sustainable growth and client satisfaction.

This is a high-impact role combining strategic relationship-building, public sector know-how, and strong commercial acumen.

What you will do at ODILO:

1. Key Account Strategy & Growth

  • Identify, engage, and manage key public and education sector accounts in Brazil.
  • Deliver against the strategic growth plan, maximizing revenue potential across public sector and educational institutions.
  • Build long-term partnerships with key stakeholders and decision-makers, including C-level, education leadership, and policy influencers.

2. Full Sales Cycle Ownership

  • Lead the entire sales cycle: prospecting, solution presentation, proposal development, negotiation, deal closing, and onboarding.
  • Meet and exceed quarterly, and annual sales targets in assigned territories and sectors.
  • Present Odilo’s solution with a clear value proposition and alignment to public education priorities (e.g. digital inclusion, teacher training, equitable access).

3. Operational Excellence

  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date CRM (Pipedrive) and ensure rigorous pipeline management and forecasting discipline.
  • Prepare executive-level presentations and responses to RFPs/tenders
  • Track public procurement calendars, funding cycles, and regional opportunities.

4. Stakeholder & Partner Management

  • Cultivate strong working relationships with key external and internal stakeholders, including CSMs, marketing, presales, legal, and operations.
  • Act as the primary commercial contact for our local Brazilian partner, ensuring alignment on priorities and coordinated go-to-market strategy.
  • Participate in joint initiatives, training, and opportunity development with the partner.

5.Thought Leadership & Innovation

  • Leverage creative and consultative sales techniques to position Odilo as a strategic ally for digital learning transformation in Brazil.
  • Stay informed of national education trends, EdTech procurement, and emerging needs in the public education space.

The ideal candidate will bring:

  • Proven experience (3+ years) in selling SaaS- based or EdTech based solutions to public institutions, ministries, or large education organizations.
  • Solid understanding of the Brazilian public education system, procurement frameworks, and government funding structures.
  • Previous experience in managing long-cycle deals, ideally in the education or public sector environment.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Strong consultative selling and stakeholder management (C-level, government)
  • CRM discipline (preferably Pipedrive) and accurate pipeline management
  • Autonomous, results-driven, with a hunter mindset
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience with public tenders and funding cycles
  • Existing network in Brazilian education or fast network builder
  • Experience with local partners/distributors
  • Experience in presenting EdTech solutions as strategic transformation tools aligned with public policy goals.
  • Familiarity with national education initiatives (e.g. inclusion, training)
  • Fluent in Spanish

Why ODILO?

Working at Odilo is about being part of a lifelong learning culture, where everyone has the possibility to take on challenges and participate in the growth of the company.

But we also offer:

  • A fast-moving and challenging job within a mission-driven company in an international, creative, and ambitious work environment.
  • Unlimited learning with Odilofy, our platform with more than 3 million contents in all formats (books, audiobooks, learning experiences, movies, courses...).
  • A salary commensurate with track record and experience.
  • Real opportunities for internal professional development.

…And more!

Sounds like a mission made for you? Then we need to talk!

Por isso passamos recentemente por umarevolução de Produto e Tecnologia na empresa, migrando toda nossa operação para um aplicativo, o PJ Hero . Ao mesmo tempo que evoluímos nossa intra, infra e dados para suportar esta nova fase.

O animador de passar por esse processo é que estamos desenvolvendo as bases do zero e conectando tudo para que o produto promova os resultados esperados pelo negócio: tenha tração, uso recorrente e cross sell.

Sobre o Desafio:

Nesta posição, você será responsável por liderar a equipe de PMs e PDs com o objetivo de implementar a visão de produto da empresa, reportando diretamente ao Diretor.

Atualmente, temos uma squad por iniciativa de produto, além da iniciativa de IA, que está em formação. Cada uma dessas frentes está em um estágio diferente do ciclo de vida de produto.

Seu desafio será gerar coesão entre elas, acelerar o desenvolvimento dos PMs e PDs e alavancar os resultados das squads. Nesse contexto, você atuará de forma próxima aos times, entrando nos detalhes e influenciando diretamente o produto por meio dos rituais com o time. Além disso, terá um papel importante na construção e aplicação de ferramentas de gestão de carreira. O crescimento do seu time será um dos seus principais objetivos.

Além da atuação direta com seus liderados, você também terá um papel relevante nos projetos estratégicos em andamento, junto aos outros líderes de tecnologia e dados. Esse grupo é responsável pela definição estratégica de tecnologia da empresa, e você será a principal voz de produto nesse contexto.

Temos uma visão clara de negócio, alinhada à visão de produto. Mas, com sua experiência e aprendizados do dia a dia, você irá colaborar diretamente na definição e nos ajustes dessa estratégia e roadmap.

Apesar de a Hero já contar com 40.000 clientes e um sólido faturamento, mantemos a agilidade de uma startup em estágio inicial. Estamos em plena expansão — um cenário muito familiar para quem já foi fundador de uma startup ou esteve entre os primeiros colaboradores, mas com mais recursos

O produto é novo e temos que colocar o MVP no ar, do zero. Em paralelo, temos outros produtos ganhando tração e que precisam ser integrados à nossa estrutura — além de um que já gera milhares de vendas por mês e requer otimização da jornada.

Você vai se dar bem se curtir um ambiente dinâmico, aprender fazendo e tiver versatilidade para lidar com diferentes estágios de produto ao mesmo tempo. Mas vai se dar bem, principalmente, se já tiver vivido tudo isso antes.

Essa vaga é para quem já viveu esse cenário — e quer viver de novo, agora com mais estrutura, time e potencial para fazer a diferença.


Main responsibilities

  • Compreender a fundo o negócio da empresa e as suas focus metrics, contribuir para a formulação de estratégias dos produto junto com a equipe;
  • Compreender profundamente o usuário e seus desafios da experiência, no produto e fora dele. Atuar na busca de soluções;
  • Desenvolvimento de pessoas deve ser um dos seus temas favoritos. Aprender, implementar e aprimorar ferramentas de desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecer detalhadamente o perfil e competências dos liderados. Planejar e trabalhar em conjunto para seu crescimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Ter rituais para analisar métricas e definir plano de ação com as equipes;
  • Manter a comunicação e o alinhamento com as lideranças das outras áreas, gerando combinado e facilitando o trabalho da equipe;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das iniciativas da equipe de perto, tendo o roadmap como referência. Retirar impedimentos e fazer negociações sempre quando necessário;
  • Ser um embaixador e referência em gestão de produtos;
  • Promover a cultura de produtos na empresa e na equipe, incorporando boas práticas, talks, frameworks e metodologias que orientem a criação de produtos de valor;
  • Acompanhar de perto artigos, concorrentes e benchmarks, para enriquecer as discussões e trazer novas oportunidades de gerar crescimento e/ou melhorar a experiência dos clientes;
  • Propor e facilitar discussões entre stakeholders para avançar na definição e de estratégias ou decisões importantes para a o negócio;
  • Trabalhar com o Diretor nos follow ups e fora deles para colaborar em iniciativas e manter todos atualizados.

Requirements and skills

  • Ter sido fundador de uma startup ou ter estado entre os primeiros funcionários;
  • Atuado pelo menos 2 ano em startup, não importa o resultado dela;
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em gerenciamento de produtos com histórico de ter feito lançamentos e busca de PMF;
  • Ampla vivência na gestão e monitoramento de cadeias de valor, com exemplos concretos de resultados alcançados nas empresas em que trabalhou;
  • Ter vivências que comprovem forte capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Ter vivência e conhecimento técnico suficiente para conduzir uma squad especialista, como dados e meios de pagamento;
  • Excelente capacidade analíticas orientada a problema, com habilidade de elaborar hipóteses e testes lógicos para elas;
  • Escuta ativa e habilidade de capturar a necessidade do cliente;
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e falada, com capacidade de síntese e simplificação para adapta-la de acordo com a situação;
  • Adorar trabalhar em equipe, em ambientes não hierárquicos;
  • Imprescindível disponibilidade para trabalhar no Híbrido 2x/semana em São Paulo

Você vai se dar bem se:

  • Gostar de estar em um ambiente acelerado;
  • Gostar de trabalhar em equipe e fazer parte de um time que trabalha sério mas de forma leve e divertida;
  • For muito organizado e orientado ao resultado/impacto;
  • Sempre investir em comunicar bem, usando recursos visuais sempre que for facilitar a compreensão - fazer o complexo se tornar simples;
  • Tiver poder de síntese e pensamento lógico;
  • Estiver buscando um desafio para construir um case;
  • Gostar de entender tecnicamente como as soluções funcionam.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ACCOUNTING & FINANCE

What We Do

Our Finance and Accounting teams build the financial infrastructure to scale our growing company. We combine analytical and strategic thinking to develop a sound financial future for our global brand. We work closely with teams across the company, international subsidiaries, as well as with external partners to ensure a world-class finance organization. Our team contains experts from fields like tax, treasury, purchasing, FP&A, and more.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a General Ledger Accountant to join our growing Brazil Finance team. This role is to be based in Brazil. You will work alongside existing members of the Brazil Finance team and partner with them and others within Epic to provide day-to-day accounting and transitional assistance, deliver high-quality financial reporting, and support ad hoc finance-related projects for Epic Brazil. This will enable us to provide complete and accurate financial reporting to the US and the United Kingdom. The role will take responsibility for building best in class reporting and control structures to ensure that Epic’s financial and operational performance is optimized, scalable and clearly communicated on a timely and accurate basis.

In this role, you will

  • Be responsible for the management of the financial accounting, including accrual and provision calculations and postings, reconciliations and financial closing activities (monthly and yearly)
  • Financial accounting Reporting for Epic UK and US
  • Management of the annual statutory audit
  • Collaborate regarding system and process enhancements
  • Fixed asset accounting and administration (including depreciation, asset tracking, and leases)
  • Tax declarations, statistical report preparation and submissions
  • Be the point of contact for any accounting or transactional queries from the Business

What we're looking for

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, any other languages are appreciated
  • 3-5 years recent and relevant work experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting. With Active CRC
  • Strong knowledge of General Ledger accounting processes and procedures, ERP systems (Senior Sistemas and Workday are preferable) and MS Excel - Google Sheets is a plus
  • Experience dealing with External Auditor requests
  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills
  • Ability to multitask and meet deadlines in a timely manner
  • Attention to detail, organization and experience in a fast-paced environment

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

description:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Head of Marketing & Communications, Brazil to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make your mark in Marketing & Communications

How you will create an impact

Reporting to the Head Marketing and Communications, Latin America and Caribbean, and to the GM for Brazil, this role has accountability of marketing and communications strategy, internal communications, content marketing, events, media relations and sales enablement in support of AIG Brazil.

The role will be responsible for establishing processes, best practices, and strategic business marketing and communications plans in support of AIG Brazil – including distribution engagement programs targeted to clients, brokers and partners; our events program, product/solutions marketing, differentiated knowledge leadership, attributable content marketing, and alignment with distribution to deliver AIG’s full capabilities to the market. This role is also responsible for developing and implementing strategic communications plans, encompassing external, internal and leadership communications, media relations and knowledge leadership to AIG’s stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead an integrated marketing and communications team, creating alignment and consistency in Marketing & Communications strategy and messaging, strengthening capabilities, and driving a culture of high performance to deliver sustainable, high-quality services.
  • Mentor and develop team members about core marketing and communications disciplines including audience targeting and segmentation, customer value propositions, business development, pipeline management, media relations, event management, industry events, campaign planning, and KPI/ROI reporting;
  • Provide guidance and oversight of marketing and communications plans and budgets aligned with AIG Brazil business priorities;
  • Develop best practices for demand-driven event marketing, knowledge leadership, content marketing and social media campaigns that facilitate sales growth;
  • Closely partner with Brazil business and functional leaders to promote and sustain a consistent AIG brand identity across businesses;
  • Manage Brazil business and industry media relations, including news releases and interviews, speaking opportunities, and issues and crisis management communications in coordination with AIG corporate teams;
  • Oversight and governance of external vendor engagement

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Significant experience in marketing and communications strategy development, execution and team leadership
  • Thorough knowledge of marketing and communications principles, product/service management, sales enablement and business development
  • Demonstrated ability to manage media relations, crisis management and corporate social responsibility efforts
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing communications and PR, content production, technology platforms and sponsorship/event management
  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling and in developing compelling and segmented narratives for key internal and external stakeholder groups
  • Ability to produce high-quality, high-volume deliverables in a dynamic environment, effectively aligning Country Marketing & Communications strategies and activities
  • Significant prior experience managing complex projects across geographies, businesses, products and segments;
  • Demonstrated ability to cultivate meaningful working relationships as a trusted and influential advisor to senior executives, and to deliver within a global matrixed environment;
  • Proven ability to lead and develop teams, driving high levels of performance and build a pipeline of talent within the function;
  • Experience within the Insurance, broader Financial Services or regulated sectors preferred;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, preferably also Spanish

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

title: Pessoa Analista de Compras Sênior
description:
Profissional responsável por gerenciar e conduzir processos estratégicos e operacionais de compras, assegurando a otimização de custos, qualidade dos produtos e serviços adquiridos e a eficiência na cadeia de suprimentos. Atua estrategicamente na negociação, homologação e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, buscando inovação, mitigação de riscos e excelência operacional.

Atuação está diretamente ligada ao cumprimento de normas, políticas internas e compliance, garantindo que as aquisições sejam feitas de forma sustentável e alinhada aos objetivos da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Estruturar processos de compras, incluindo a elaboração de RFI (Request for Information), RFQ (Request for Quotation) e RFP (Request for Proposal) para garantir competitividade e transparência.
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de compras, desde a identificação da necessidade até a entrega e pagamento, garantindo que os processos sigam as diretrizes da empresa.
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos, assegurando qualidade, confiabilidade e competitividade.
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e auditorias a fornecedores, garantindo conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos.
  • Negociar cláusulas contratuais e elaborar contratos comerciais, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, custos e qualidade dos produtos e serviços.
  • Implementar práticas de Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores (SRM), garantindo relacionamento saudável e de longo prazo com fornecedores.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado, oscilações de preços e riscos econômicos (como variação cambial, custo de matérias-primas e inflação).
  • Implementar estratégias para redução de custos e maximização de eficiência operacional, aplicando conceitos como TCO (Custo total por propriedade) e should cost analysis (Custo x Benefício).
  • Assegurar a conformidade dos processos de compras com as normas fiscais, tributárias e auditorias aplicáveis.
  • Utilizar dashboards e ferramentas analíticas (Power BI, Excel avançado, Tableau) para suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Aplicar metodologias Lean e Six Sigma para redução de desperdícios e melhoria contínua dos processos de suprimentos.
  • Monitorar os níveis de estoque e consumo, propondo estratégias de compras just-in-time (JIT) para redução de custos e otimização de armazenagem.
  • Planejar e gerenciar operações de importação e desembaraço aduaneiro, garantindo conformidade regulatória e eficiência no tempo de entrega.
  • Analisar o impacto logístico das aquisições, incluindo fretes, armazenagem e modais de transporte.
  • Participar ativamente do planejamento orçamentário da área de compras, garantindo alinhamento financeiro e previsibilidade.
  • Promover inovação na cadeia de suprimentos, buscando novas tecnologias e fornecedores que agreguem valor ao negócio.
  • Demais atividades inerentes da função.

These projects span various industries as we partner with customers to build enterprise IT solutions based on Red Hat platforms that are the trusted, consistent, and comprehensive foundation for any enterprise.
In other words, a Junior Consultant at Red Hat can be you…
So, are you ready to launch your technical career with Red Hat? If so, we are looking for passionate individuals early in their technical career to help us unlock the world’s potential.
What You Will Do
During your first year as a Junior Consultant, you will engage in a cohort-based program. Through this experience, you will:

  • Learn all about Red Hat and how we support our customers to address their technical developmental and strategic business challenges with our portfolio and services
  • Build a strong support network of your Peers, Manager, Mentor and other Red Hatters within and outside of your customer projects
  • Develop technical skills in the Red Hat portfolio that span Cloud, Automation and AI solutions by completing training programs and attaining industry-recognized certifications
  • Apply your technical skills as you engage in meaningful customer projects, experiences and job shadowing opportunities
  • Enhance your professional capabilities through real-world experiences working directly with customers and participating in skill development opportunities
  • Focus on your personal and professional development as you grow your career at Red Hat
What You Will Bring
  • Passion and curiosity for open source technology and desire to build a career within the Tech industry
  • Strong technical skills in computer science, IT, AI, or related fields gained through university programs, upskilling bootcamps, certificate programs, military experience, etc.
  • Demonstrated experience applying technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills in an Enterprise IT-related project. Direct experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, and related technologies is preferred.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites for project work and to local Red Hat offices to engage other Red Hat associates
  • Effective communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with internal teams and external customers
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken Portuguese
About Red Hat
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.
Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

At Hydro-Thermal Corporation success is attributed to people who are committed to technical competence, are responsive to customers' needs, are friendly, are willing to work hard, have complete integrity, and are active in our industry and in the local communities.

TheRegional Sales Manager is primarily responsible for developing and securing strategic sales opportunities for HTC’s direct steam injection (DSI) technology for general industrial heat transfer applications in South America (mainly Brazil). This includes:

  • Increasing the region’s market share, revenue growth and customer base by securing installations in targeted applications;
  • Providing market development and technical sales support for existing sales channel partners;
  • Establishing additional sales channel partners that service open geographic areas, or niche market segments;
  • Securing sales, on a direct basis, where sales channel partners are not established.

Hydro-Thermal’s DSI systems are used for thermal treatment during physical or chemical processing of raw materials/products while in a liquefied slurry. Typical industries include: chemical, food, beverage, grain milling, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, biotech, pulp and paper, wastewater treatment and petrochemical.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop a comprehensive regional sales plan in respective industry that details programs and strategies to achieve and surpass annual HTC financial goals, business objectives, and personal objectives.
  • Prior to the start of each fiscal year, meet with each channel partner to develop their annual HTC marketing plan to meet respective quotas – review progress on a quarterly basis.
  • Increase HTC “mindshare” with each sales channel partner to establish stronger preference for presenting DSI for heat transfer applications.
  • Ensure that sales leads, are followed and that their disposition is adequately documented in SalesLogix.
  • Evaluate new channel partners to replace ineffective ones, and/or to drive further penetration into niche markets or new geographic areas.
  • Conduct joint sales calls to ensure that the HTC product line is properly presented and to provide assistance in developing the market.
  • Conduct “lunch-and-learn” sessions to increase technical product knowledge and market development capabilities.

Educational Requirements:

  • Minimum qualifications – BA Business Administration, BS Mechanical or Chemical Engineering degree.
  • Preferred qualifications – MBA, MS Mechanical or Chemical Engineering degree, Professional Engineer certification.

Required Experience:

  • Fluent in Portuguese
  • Between 7-10 years of experience with managing a comprehensive sales process for technical, engineered products and capital equipment.
  • Successful achievement of increasing annual sales quotas
  • Sales management responsibility for developing a results-oriented network of industrial sales channel partners (manufacturers’ representatives, distributors),
  • Sales experience with original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s) and national accounts.
  • Proficiency with PC and Windows Operating system, Microsoft Office Suite and SalesLogix, or similar contact resource management (CRM) software.

Travel Requirements: The position requires approximately 40-50% travel within respective territory.

title: Character Concept Artist (IP)
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Character Concept Artist to help us continue to shape the future of Fortnite. As a Concept Artist, you will work with the development teams to create memorable and compelling characters that exude personality and style. You will use your artistic expertise in color, composition, shape, and visual design to help push our iconic visual style. Your craft expertise in character design will provide the inspiration to continue pushing the boundaries of what Fortnite means to our players.

In this role, you will

  • Collaborate closely with the Art Directors and core development team to drive and visualize different types of content across the Fortnite universe
  • Produce unique, memorable, and compelling characters that fit the Fortnite style
  • Create character designs in a variety of body shapes, race, and aesthetics
  • Based on visual direction from the Art Director, collaborate on the visual style and ensure our designs are of Epic quality bar, and create and iterate unique and stunning designs within a determined production schedule
  • Coordinate with other art, design, and production teams to help accomplish the goals of the product

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years experience in the game industry working in AAA game development
  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Senior Concept Artist role
  • Experience working with intellectual properties
  • A portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity, and craftsmanship
  • Excellent traditional artistic skills with a strong grasp of composition, anatomy, color theory, perspective, lighting, environment, architectural, character, costume and graphic design
  • Effective leader, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate with internal and external teams
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

TBNR (T he B est N ever R est) is a top YouTube production company managing the massive channels and digital media brands of Preston, Brianna Arsement, and more. A posição exige forte habilidade em análise financeira, gestão de processos e liderança de equipes multidisciplinares.


Main responsibilities

  • Controlar um balanço superior a R$ 500 milhões, incluindo as áreas de Real Estate, Energia, Infraestrutura e Jurídica.
  • Real Estate: Controlar aluguéis, tributos, utilities e facilities, garantindo a conformidade e eficiência financeira nas operações.
  • Energia: Gerenciar a pagadoria e medição de contratos de mercado cativo, livre e geração distribuída (GD), incluindo a análise e acompanhamento das variáveis que impactam os custos e receitas.
  • Infraestrutura: Gerenciar a área de infraestrutura de dutos, postes e direitos de passagem, assegurando o controle adequado e a manutenção das condições contratuais.
  • Jurídico: Acompanhar e controlar as questões jurídicas relacionadas às áreas sob sua responsabilidade, trabalhando em conjunto com o time jurídico para mitigar riscos e custos.
  • Fechamento e Projeções de Resultados: Coordenar e monitorar o ciclo de fechamento financeiro, garantindo a precisão das provisões e alinhamento com o regime de competência.
  • Controle de Investimentos: Acompanhar e controlar os investimentos realizados, assegurando a viabilidade financeira e o retorno esperado.
  • Coordenação Orçamentária: Coordenar o processo orçamentário anual, com foco na previsão de receitas e despesas, alinhando todas as áreas envolvidas para garantir a consistência e a precisão do planejamento.
  • Projetos chave: Mapear processos, melhorar gaps funcionais, sistêmicos e de governança, e identificar singergias com outras áreas de planejamento e controle da companhia.

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.

title: FX Art Lead Porto Alegre (Brazil) Epic Games Technical Art Senior (5+ years)
description:
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for an experienced FX Art Lead to join our team working on Fortnite. A successful candidate should have a strong sense of dramatic effects and an understanding of how to recreate them in a real time particle editor. They will be first and foremost a team player, while also having the ability to be self-motivated and work autonomously. If you have a strong sense of weight, timing, motion, and you demonstrate technical aptitude with Materials and Logic, we are ready for you to bring those abilities to execute outstanding FX in our games.

In this role, you will

Create all art needed for the visual effects, including FX concept, proto and final FX, with blueprint and Niagara logic, models, textures, materials, camera effects, animations and particles

Execute on a range of visual effects styles from realistic to stylized

Lead a growing team of effects artists, mentor and coach artists you work with

Collaborate with other discipline teams to produce cohesive game experience

Partner with external vendors, onboard and support production of FX outside of Epic Games

Drive the style and feel of Fortnite’s FX

Work closely with the production on the schedule to deliver the FX in a timely manner

What we’re looking for

Must have a strong reel/portfolio showing executed Real-Time FX work

Critical eye for the timing, animation, and motion of real-world objects and visual FX with an ability to bring dramatic FX to life with a flair

Good instincts for realistic and stylized FX

Ability to create all art needed for the FX

Experience in VFX (games or film) is a must. Shipped AAA game titles is a plus

Familiarity with UE5 or other real-time engine art pipelines is a big plus

If you have a portfolio/reel/website you'd like to share, please hyperlink it to your resume, or submit it as an attachment with your application. (OPTIONAL - art roles only)

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees and dependents and offer coverage for supplemental medical, dental, vision, critical illness, telemedicine, Life and AD&D, long term disability insurance as well as weekly indemnity (short term disability) and a retirement savings plan with a competitive employer match. In addition to the EAP (employee assistance program), we also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

  • Excellent upper-intermediate English communication skills.

title: Gerente Geral de Operações
description:
Gerente Geral de Operações será responsável pelas áreas:

· Operações das unidades, em 22 cidades e 7 estados.

· Gente,

· Compras e Logística

Estará baseado em São Paulo e irá reportar-se ao CEO.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO:

Garantir a excelência operacional das áreas sob sua responsabilidade, em rede nacional, liderando uma equipe descentralizada de forma inspiradora, assertiva e orientada a resultados, promovendo cultura de alta performance e clima organizacional positivo.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

1. Gestão de Equipes e Liderança

· Coordenar e desenvolver os Gerentes Regionais.

· Promover alinhamento estratégico entre unidades e a matriz.

· Garantir comunicação clara, assertiva e constante com todas as unidades.

· Disseminar boas práticas e fomentar sinergia entre as operações.

· Realizar visitas periódicas às unidades.

2. Gestão Estratégica e de Resultados

· Participar ativamente do planejamento estratégico da empresa.

· Garantir o cumprimento de metas operacionais, financeiras e de pessoas.

· Elaborar relatórios de desempenho e apresentar resultados aos Diretores.

· Propor e liderar projetos de inovação e melhoria contínua.

3. Relacionamento Interdepartamental

· Integrar as operações com demais áreas.

· Ser o elo entre a Diretoria e as unidades operacionais.

4. Gestão de Pessoas e Cultura Organizacional

· Implementar políticas e práticas de Recursos Humanos alinhadas à estratégia corporativa.

· Garantir o desenvolvimento e a capacitação das lideranças locais.

· Monitorar indicadores de clima organizacional, engajamento e turnover.

· Fomentar um ambiente colaborativo, motivador e orientado para resultados.

· Liderar processos de avaliação de desempenho e feedback.

5. Gestão de Compras e Logística

· Estruturar e padronizar processos de compras, centralizando negociações estratégicas.

· Assegurar o abastecimento das unidades, evitando rupturas e excessos.

· Garantir a negociação com fornecedores buscando melhores condições comerciais.

· Otimizar o mix de produtos conforme perfil de consumo regional.

· Monitorar indicadores financeiros: custos, margem e lucratividade.

· Planejar e coordenar a logística entre fornecedores e unidades, assegurando eficiência.

· Definir e monitorar parâmetros logísticos: estoque mínimo, frequência de abastecimento.

· Implantar e acompanhar KPIs logísticos: nível de serviço, tempo de entrega, acuracidade de estoque.

· Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos logísticos.
REQUISITOS DO CARGO:

Formação:

· Ensino superior completo (Administração, Logística, Engenharia, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas).

· Desejável ter Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas pertinentes à função.

Experiência:

· Mais de 5 anos de experiência comprovada em gestão de operações, compras, logística e pessoas em empresas com as mesmas características .

· Vivência em gestão de equipes distribuídas geograficamente.

· Experiência com indicadores operacionais, gestão por metas e planejamento estratégico.
